sentences.text: (By Ms. Hemlata Kshatriya - Panel Lawyer)

This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e court  following:
 ORDER
This is the first appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act seeking regular bail.

2. The appellant is in custody since 06.03.2024 in connection with Crime No.346/2023 registered at Police Station - Aadegaon, District Seoni (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
376(2)(n), 506 of the IPC and Section 3(2)(v), 3(1)(w)(i1) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act.
3.

As per prosecution story, allegation against the appellant is that victim lodged the report against him alleging that appellant met with her and he forced her to go with him and he took her to his house where he forcibly committed rape and threatened her for dire consequences.
He also threatened her to defame her.
On the basis of allegation, Police registered the case against the applicant under the aforesaid Sections.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is 30 years of married lady.
There is delay in lodging the FIR.
In MLC report, no internal or external injuries were found.
DNA report is also negative.

1 take considerable time to conclude, therefore, he may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Considering the overall facts of the case, I deem it appropriate to release the appellant on bail,
therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, this appeal is allowed.
7.

It is directed that appellant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
In future, if any offence is registered against the applicant, then bail order granted by this Court shall stand automatically cancelled.

9. It is further directed that the appellant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
